`game.js` is **9280 lines, ~145k tokens**. Reading it whole is the single most expensive thing a packet can do, and it buries the useful code in noise.

**Read the section you need, not the file.** Every section below is a
`// ---- Name ----` banner in `game.js`:

```
Read(game.js, offset=<start>, limit=<end - start + 1>)
```
